resources.string: Fill in the token and chat_id
✅ Test: the app is connected to Telegram
Failed to send. Check the token/chat_id and your internet connection.
⚠️ SMS permission not granted — forwarding will not work
⚠️ Battery optimization is on — the app may be put to sleep

1. Create a bot via @BotFather and paste the token.
2. Send a message to your bot, open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates and copy the chat_id.
3. Save, grant the permission, send a test.
4. Turn off battery optimization for the app so it does not go to sleep.
